description.text:
Summon (唤) is one of the three booster packs of Shining Synergy (交相辉映), the second Simplified Chinese release, on sale from 18 January 2023 alongside Shower (沐), Supreme (魁) and a GX starter deck. Like the first release, its cards come from the Sun & Moon series. Shining Synergy brought TAG TEAM Pokémon-GX and TAG TEAM Supporters to the Simplified Chinese game, and with them Character Rare (CHR) cards, full-art cards showing a Pokémon together with a trainer, and special art versions of some cards. Five-card packs held one holo card, 25-card packs five.

Summon holds the Fire, Darkness and Fairy Pokémon and the Trainers that go with them. Eevee & Snorlax GX is on its cover. Its other TAG TEAMs include Reshiram & Charizard GX, Umbreon & Darkrai GX, Greninja & Zoroark GX, Gardevoir & Sylveon GX and Moltres & Zapdos & Articuno GX, and Cynthia & Caitlin is its TAG TEAM Supporter. Its main cards are numbered out of 150; two CHR cards, full-art and special art cards and gold cards are numbered past it, up to 192.
